goal: Allow disabling periodic unconfirmed transaction rebroadcasts without turning off initial broadcasts
Prevent privacy leaks that reveal node ownership of transactions to peers during rebroadcast cycles
agreement: Unaddressed objection: disabling rebroadcasts by default harms the wallet (achow101)
Suggests also disabling mempool resubmission on startup if rebroadcast is disabled (mzumsande)
Worry that defaulting to off harms users who rely on rebroadcasts was answered by author (vicjuma)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes a privacy leak where periodic rebroadcasts announce wallet ownership to all peers
Gives users explicit control over rebroadcasting separate from initial transaction transmission
